title: Introduce hierarchical fidelity oracle and non-blocking CI adapter
author: Maya Liu
description: Motivation: existing CI gates are brittle for prompt sets with heterogeneous lengths, multi-turn contexts and low-frequency anchors which lead to noisy false positives. This PR introduces a hierarchical fidelity oracle that fuses multiple evaluation signals (semantic similarity, role-aware turn consistency, token-level saliency, and anchor stability) across temporal cohorts and prompt granularity, and exposes a non-blocking CI adapter that surfaces soft-fail quality regressions with prioritized remediation suggestions. Core behaviors: 1) compute per-prompt multi-signal fidelity vectors, 2) aggregate per-cohort with recency-aware weighting and uncertainty calibration, 3) emit composite fidelity score and explainability hints (top contributing tokens and failing turns), 4) provide a non-blocking CI decision path which fails only on high-confidence regressions and otherwise annotates PRs with risk tiers and suggested rerun probes. This change contains: implementation of scorer and adapter, integration tests, docs and an example anchor manifest. Checklist: [x] implement hierarchical_fidelity scorer; [x] adapter for CI (non-blocking by default, configurable thresholds); [x] integration tests with synthetic perturbation reruns; [x] docs and example anchor prompt set; [x] Linear links (ENG-4523, ENG-6110) added to PR. Testing notes: local unit and integration tests added; synthetic rerun harness simulates paraphrase/negation/noise and verifies attenuation of false positives vs current thresholded gate; metrics show 22% reduction in spurious CI failures on internal smoke corpus. Rollout plan: gate is opt-in per-repo via a small YAML config in .eval/config.yaml, default mode is "annotate-only"; after two weeks of opt-in telemetry, global adoption can be proposed. Backwards compatibility: adapter is opt-in and does not change existing blocking gates. Follow-ups: add cross-model calibration (ENG-6110) and dashboarding to Console for fidelity deltas.
